📝 Mayor's Blog Update (Published: September 1, 2026)

Today, September 1, is Disaster Prevention Day in Japan. On September 1, 1923 (Taisho 12), the Great Kanto Earthquake struck, and many lives were lost.

When an earthquake happens, it's important to stay where you are and follow three steps: drop low, cover your head, and hold still. We held an earthquake drill (ShakeOut) across all city offices today.

First and foremost, we must protect ourselves. Please practice these steps so you can act instinctively if a real earthquake occurs.
